Representation level: L1 (proxy). This is the Three.js sampled-frame baseline, not a Blender-protocol reproduction.

## Geometry
- Astronaut A (shown only in the opening shot) and astronaut B (wears a boxy manoeuvring-unit backpack and red thigh bands; the single astronaut in all later shots).
